result_review.summary: The compact result reports exact main identity matches and one adjacent negative-IFLG slot for every one of the 801 pre-observed CO2 flag-1 target contributors, including matches through panel 496.

review_method: Read terminal execution.json and result.json only; no raw TAPE3, coefficient file, solver output, or arithmetic was opened/recomputed.
scope_limit: This validates record identity and adjacency cardinality for the prior observed contributor roster only. It does not validate companion coefficients or YI/GI/SPPSP values, census all candidate/rejected lines, prove a physical coupling-group closure, or validate negative OD. The 801 identities are selected from the already-derived 837 reason-12 roster; this review did not reread raw TAPE3 or redo joins.
